 Shopee partners with Vibrant Ho Chi Minh City 2026 to bring a series of shopping deals for the 11.11 event.
 VTV.vn - Shopee is launching online shopping activities, starting with the 11.11 mega sale and many offers for consumers.
 Đài truyền hình Việt Nam • 11/11/2026 Follow Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e Add Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e 0 Recently, the People's Committee of Ho Chi Minh City announced the implementation of the year-end 2026 - Lunar New Year 2027 stimulus program called Vibrant Ho Chi Minh City (Vibrant HCMC), aiming to promote trade, stimulate consumer demand, and create additional momentum for the market during the peak shopping season. The program is supported by businesses from various sectors, including e-commerce platforms such as Shopee.
 Vibrant HCMC stimulates consumption across the city during the year-end season. 
 The Vibrant HCMC program is implemented by the Ho Chi Minh City Department of Industry and Trade under the direction of the City People's Committee, in coordination with the Vietnam International Finance Corporation (VIFC-HCMC), relevant departments, agencies, and units.
 Bearing the message "Ho Chi Minh City - Vibrant with Every Experience," the program, running from November 2026 to February 2027, connects commercial, service, cultural, and tourism activities within the city. 
 The Chairman of the People's Committee of Ho Chi Minh City, along with city leaders and representatives from various departments and agencies, attended the program launch ceremony within the framework of the Autumn Economic Forum, which took place on October 28, 2026.
 You may also like The highlight of Vibrant HCMC is the connection between online channels and shopping spaces, events, and services in the city. The program's digital ecosystem is oriented towards connecting five experiential groups: centralized shopping, e-commerce, tourism and experiences, digital payments, and digital finance. The coordination between management agencies, financial institutions, commercial and service businesses, and technology platforms helps to implement demand-stimulating activities synchronously, aiming to expand consumer access opportunities and develop markets for businesses.
 Notably, Vibrant HCMC aims to generate over 30 trillion VND in total merchandise value (GMV) through its e-commerce and payment platforms, with approximately 10-11 trillion VND expected as additional transaction value from the program. This is also one of the city's efforts to promote the role of e-commerce and digital platforms in boosting trade and consumption.
 Shopee joins the online shopping campaign. 
 As one of the e-commerce platforms partnering with the program, Shopee collaborated in implementing and participating in trade promotion activities and stimulating consumer demand throughout the duration of Vibrant HCMC. Through its online shopping ecosystem and phased promotional programs, Shopee contributed to connecting consumers with a diverse range of products, brands, and reputable local sellers, while also creating more opportunities for businesses participating in the program to reach customers. 
 Shopee's 11.11 campaign is in support of the "Vibrant HCMC" program.
 The series of events will kick off with the "Shopee 11.11 - The Biggest Sale of the Year" shopping program, running from October 26th to November 13th, featuring many outstanding offers such as site-wide vouchers with discounts up to VND 350,000 for orders from VND 600,000, Super Voucher Xtra with discounts up to VND 720,000 for orders from VND 2 million, and discounts up to VND 700,000 for orders from VND 1 million on Shopee Mall. These programs apply to a wide range of product categories including electronics, phones and accessories, consumer goods, lifestyle, home goods, and many others. In addition, ShopeeVIP customers will also have access to exclusive shopping deals. 
 You may also like As part of the program, Shopee is offering a series of attractive shopping deals for consumers.
 Detailed information about current promotions and shopping deals is updated on the Shopee app or the 11.11 program page (https://shopee.vn/m/11-11).
 In addition, residents and tourists can also access the official portal of the Vibrant HCMC - Vibrant Experience program (https://songdong.hochiminhcity.gov.vn/), search for Shopee in the list of Partner Programs to learn more about related consumer stimulus and trade promotion activities.
